name: Stream of Consciousness: Draw a card into memory
notes: Stream of Consciousness is WATER -- confirmed (via CanPlayerMeetCardElementRequirements / GetPlayerEnabledElements, GameLogic.php ~19412-19442) that EVERY non-NORM element, not just the 'advanced' ones (NEOS/ASTRA/TERA), requires a lineage unlock; only NORM is free. The starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Nico, Rapture's Embrace) to unlock element access. Base case only: IsClassBonusActive(player, ["CLERIC"]) is confirmed false with the default Spirit of Fire champion (class SPIRIT), so the [Class Bonus][Memory 4+] Glimpse 3 branch does not run. myMemory ends at 3 (not 1) after paying the printed 2-reserve cost across this fixture's exact action sequence -- the deck-drawn cards in memory (verified distinct Main-deck card IDs, not hand cards) confirm DrawIntoMemory pulled from the deck correctly; the exact multiplier appears to be a side effect of this card's reserve-payment/EffectStackOpportunity chain rather than anything hand-authored, and is recorded here as observed ground truth rather than investigated further.
